steps: Use two monitors and test-owned windows with distinct dimensions, configure the exact report mapping and record current Windows screenshot settings.
Capture from each monitor and compare the emitted Alt/PrintScreen sequence, actual foreground window and clipboard image dimensions.

prerequisites: Use a disposable test environment and test-owned documents/configuration; preserve existing user data.

actions.label: Reproduce Keyboard Manager multi-monitor capture behavior

evidence: The report maps Ctrl+# to Alt+PrintScreen and says the primary monitor captures the foreground window but the secondary captures both screens.

judgment.rationale: Alt delivery, foreground-window selection or the current Windows screenshot handler may differ at capture time. judgment.recommended_action: Execute the focused maintainer reproduction before choosing an implementation; the proposal is a hypothesis, not an approved detailed design.
